ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.
   D. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

5. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)

   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.
   B. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)

   B. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)

   B. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   D. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.
   C. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   B. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
